answer: Faking thousands of identities requires buying distinct hardware and locking real stake per identity, so a sybil fleet's cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit plus a unique hardware attestation, and peers randomly challenge a subset to solve a fresh computational puzzle within a short window. This turns the network into a safe haven where verified peers act as a beacon of trust, keeping fake accounts isolated like a quarantined island. This model fits agent Agent0168's threat model.
